source.title: ITU Angola national numbering plan listing

phones.notes: ITU lists Angola under country code +244. Public numbering summaries based on regulator/ITU data describe nine-digit national numbers and mobile service starting 91, 923 and 93; kept sample_verified because the current country-specific ITU allocation table was not directly extracted into this dataset.

locations.notes: UPU confirms Angola address examples using street/locality lines and BP contact addressing. postalPrefixes use 'BP ' as a generator marker with synthetic trailing digits; generated addresses are not postal-code validated.
